title: santalum lanaiense
intro: Santalum lanaiense, commonly known as the Lanai sandalwood or Niulani, is a species of sandalwood tree native to Hawaii. This plant is valued for its aromatic wood and essential oils, which have been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Santalum lanaiense include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include santalol, a compound responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, relaxation, and antispasmodic effects, making it a popular ingredient in aromatherapy and traditional Hawaiian medicine.
